correctness.rationale: The actual orbit-union complex K_m is homeomorphic to the genuine geometric fixed set: an invariant face contributes one orbit-barycenter vertex for each whole orbit in its support, and fixed barycentric weights give the inverse. Direct maximum-Hamming-distance casework shows the orbit graph consists of two VR(Q_m;2) copies joined by 2^m matching A/B bridges, and independent C_z cone vertices, each with link two contractible m-simplices plus m+1 bridge edges, hence m circles. These links attach along difference loops x_w x_z^{-1}. As the lower-cube complexes are simply connected (the published wedge-of-3-spheres theorem, with small m simplices), maps of graph links are determined by these words. Homotopy cofiber reduction and spanning-tree cancellation eliminate the 2^m-1 bridge generators integrally, leaving m 2^m-(2^m-1) 2-spheres and the two existing 3-sphere wedges. Checked small m=1..4 by separately constructing Hamming orbit unions and mod-two boundaries; finite tests do not prove integral homotopy but agree on ranks. No theorem for arbitrary permutations/other radii.
